description: Update fields on an existing catalog category by id: name, parent, slug, description, Google category, marketplaceCategories and translations. Provide a patch with at least one field; use list_categories first to find the id and current values. The slug is normalized to Latin. The parent must exist in this workspace and cannot create a loop. Translations REPLACE the whole set when sent (an empty array removes them all) and are left untouched when omitted — translate only the category's own name and description, add no facts. marketplaceCategories ({ prom, rozetka, olx, amazon, google_merchant }) links marketplace category ids: a string sets one, null clears it, an omitted platform is left untouched. Look ids up with search_marketplace_categories first and never guess them; the format is always checked on write, and against the marketplace while it is connected (OLX must be a leaf category; a Google id must exist in the Google taxonomy). The result is the updated category and echoes the operating workspace.

id.description: The category id returned by list_categories.

patch.description: The category fields to update; include at least one changed field.

description.description: Prose a storefront shows at the top of the category shelf, in the workspace's base language (up to 4000 characters). Send null to clear it.

googleProductCategory.description: Google Product Taxonomy id or full path for this category (for Google Shopping). Prefer marketplaceCategories.google_merchant, which this field is an alias of; send the Google category in one place only. Separate from the name; send null to clear it.

marketplaceCategories.description: The category's id on each marketplace, keyed by platform. Omit a platform to leave it untouched, send null to clear it. Every value is checked on write (format always; against the marketplace itself while it is connected) — find valid ids with search_marketplace_categories first.

amazon.description: Amazon product type (e.g. SHOES, HOME_BED_AND_BATH) — the schema Amazon validates every listing of this category against; no Amazon listing can be created without it. Upper-cased on write. While Amazon is connected it is checked against Amazon. Take it from search_marketplace_categories, never guess. Not inherited by subcategories. Send null to clear it.

google_merchant.description: Google Product Taxonomy entry for Google Shopping — the numeric id (e.g. 187). An exact English taxonomy path is accepted and stored as its id. Take it from search_marketplace_categories, never guess. Subcategories without their own value inherit the nearest parent's. Send null to clear it.

olx.description: OLX category id (digits) that products of this category publish into. Must be a FINAL (leaf) OLX category — OLX refuses an advert in a parent. While OLX is connected it is checked against OLX and its path is stored for display. Take it from search_marketplace_categories, never guess. Not inherited by subcategories. Send null to clear it.

prom.description: Prom.ua rubric id (digits) — exported as <portal_category_id>; Prom refuses an offer without it. Prom publishes no category directory: take the id from search_marketplace_categories (rubrics observed on the merchant's own Prom listings) or from the user, never guess. Not inherited by subcategories. Send null to clear it.

rozetka.description: Rozetka category id (digits) — exported as rz_id, which links this category to Rozetka's tree. Take it from search_marketplace_categories, never guess. Not inherited by subcategories. Send null to clear it.

name.description: The category name in the workspace's base language, up to 120 characters. Must be unique among categories with the same parent.

parentId.description: Id of the parent category from list_categories, to nest this one under it; it must exist in this workspace. Omit or send null for a top-level category.

slug.description: URL segment for the category. Normalized to lowercase Latin letters, digits and hyphens whatever is sent (Cyrillic is transliterated); derived from the name when omitted.

translations.description: Category name (and optional description) per locale. Omit to leave existing translations untouched; when sent it REPLACES the whole set, so an empty array removes them all.

locale.description: Content locale, one of the workspace's supported languages.

name: update_category
title: Update category
